intro: Deliah's Ring is an engraved piece of jewelry recovered from a corpse pile amassed by the Rot Hide gnolls in Silverpine Forest. Bearing the inscription 'For Deliah', the keepsake offers a grim trail tracing back to a plague victim stolen from Tirisfal's mass graves.

p: Discovered upon the pockmarked, relatively fresh hand of a corpse among gnoll mounds in Silverpine Forest, the ring is inscribed simply: 'For Deliah'. The discovery reveals that the local Rot Hide gnolls are not merely scavenging battlefields—they are actively raiding the mass graves of Tirisfal Glades and ferrying human and Forsaken corpses south to Fenris Isle for their own vile purposes.
